responsibility: Implements the executable backend definitions for the base set of Arm MVE ACLE intrinsics. This file instantiates many concrete arm_mve::function_base subclasses and global function objects for individual intrinsic families, providing their gimple folding where applicable and, most importantly, their RTL expansion into specific MVE insn codes, unspecs, predicated forms, contiguous/scatter load-store sequences, reinterpretations, and special cases such as uninitialized vectors. In conjunction with the shape and declaration tables, it is the source that maps a resolved MVE builtin call to the exact target pattern or helper sequence used by the Arm backend.
same_name_distinction: Defines the actual function_base implementations and instantiated builtin handler objects for the MVE base intrinsic families. Unlike arm-mve-builtins-base.def, which only lists which families exist and which shape/predication metadata they use, and unlike arm-mve-builtins-base.h, which only declares extern pointers to those handlers, this .cc file contains the executable folding and RTL expansion behavior.
